in_hebrew.name: Barty
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of Tarsus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Barty הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Bartholomaios, meaning 'son of Tarsus'. This name appears in the New Testament as one of the twelve apostles.

in_greek.name: Barty
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Son of Tarsus
in_greek.long_meaning: Barty είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Bartholomaios, meaning 'son of Tarsus'. This name appears in the New Testament as one of the twelve apostles.

in_latin.name: Barty
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Son of Tarsus
in_latin.long_meaning: Barty est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Bartholomaios, meaning 'son of Tarsus'. This name appears in the New Testament as one of the twelve apostles.
